## Purpose

Breaks work into bite-sized tasks (2-5 min each). Every task has exact file paths, complete code, verification steps. Part of obra/superpowers agentic skills framework & software development methodology. Prompt-only skills (no observed hooks/scripts in source-list); composable workflow: brainstorming -&gt; writing-plans -&gt; executing-plans + test-driven-development + verification-before-completion. Complements local orchestrator/test-architect/review.
